Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Fall of the Camarilla 2
October 16 2021
Paris, France
3R+F
16 players
Vincent Ripoll
www.vekn.net/event-calendar/event/9939

-- 2GW7 + 4VP

Deck Name: Enkidu CEL/PRO
Author: Ankha
Description: A deck I hadn't played in a while, with some changes I didn't even remember compared to the version I used to win the French NC in 2012 www.vekn.fr/decks/twd.htm#2012fncrf
The deck was originally a multi-rush, but since I reduced the number of alternate rushes, I never managed to perform two rushes in the same turn during the tournament.
I made a few mistakes in the first round that cost me the GW, but the 4-players format (16 players only) greatly helped making GW in the other rounds.
The final round was fairly easy to win once my predator and grand-predator had annihilated each other.

Final seating:
> 1 Serge Cirri (FoS BS with Nefertiti merged)
> 2 Christophe Verdier (Weenie Samedi equip / rush)
> 3 Vincent Ripoll (Enkidu)
> 4 Axel Huet (fat FoS Bleed with Nakhthorheb)

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
I lost the detailed report when posting, so here is a one sentence review per round.

Round 1
Antonin, under pressure from an inexperienced Lasombra, smartly counters my famous yoyo kill and sweeps the table thanks to the acceleration provided by a surprise Blessing of the Loa and a desperate bleed from my prey in Daring who bounces twice and hits me.

Antonin GW 4

Round 2
Taking advantage of Gilles' overconfidence, Candice kills him before succumbing under the combined rushes of Enkidu and Christophe's Nana who will not have drawn his Enkidu, and who will be proved that Enkidu is stronger in combat.

Ankha GW 3 Candice 1

Round 3
After having softened the vampires of Eleonore, my prey, Enkidu makes reign of terror with his Raven Spies and beats everyone.
GW 4.

Final
Having dozed off during the first quarter of an hour, I notice when I wake up that my predator and my grand-predator have killed each other, leaving only one question hanging: will Axel kill Antonin before I make the table?

Serge 1 VP Ankha GW 4

Prince of Paris, France
